CustomField.description: The Form Template Page this stage represents. The stages overview reads the page's label, description, estimated time, optional flag and position through this lookup. A page cannot be deleted while stage records still point at it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The page this stage tracks progress for. One stage record is auto-created per page when a new Form Submission is inserted on a Stages-Mode template.
CustomField.label: Form Template Page
